The problem this solution exists for
Alerts flood; correlation is human; incident duration depends on who's on call; changes cause outages nobody predicted.

We build the AIOps backbone: event correlation across estate, SLO-based alerting on symptoms, agentic remediation for known classes, change-risk models feeding release policy, and chaos drills that prove recovery.

The solution runs on KYC Management System and Fleet Management System: Hundreds of agents as one governed, measurable workforce.  The governed data estate every intelligence program silently depends on.

challenger models and policies quarterly; conformance monitoring; annual value audit against baseline.
